player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id}. Kuna wasa da Guess The Number. Dole ne ku yi tunanin lambar tsakanin {min_number} da {max_number} a cikin {max_turns} juyawa. Yayin da kuka shiga cikin tunaninku, wasan zai ba ku shawarwari kamar 'mafi girma' ko 'ƙasa'. Kuna iya ba da amsarku ta kowace hanya. Lambar da aka nannade a cikin masu kusurwa za a ɗauka a matsayin tunaninku. Misali, [5]. Yayin da kuke wasa, za a haɗa tarihin tunaninku a ƙasa. Yi amfani da bayanin don kammala wasan kafin ku rasa tunanin. Shigar da tunaninku.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin motsawa mara inganci. Mai kunnawa {player_id} bai amsa da ingantaccen "[number]" ba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ba daidai ba ne. Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya yi tsammani lambar da ke waje da keɓaɓɓen kewayon.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Ba daidai ba ne. Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya riga ya gane lambar.

game_message.target_higher: Adadin da ake son a kashe ya fi haka.
game_message.target_lower: Lambar da ake son a kai ta fi haka.

outcome.win: Barka dai, ka yi tunanin lambar daidai.
outcome.turn_limit: Iyakar zagaye ta kai matsaya. Guess: {guess}, Target: {target}
